required_consumer_behavior: Keep the existing UI Order writer as the active path and rollback authority until an independently observed cohort cutover is approved.
Converge the competing UI Order-create surfaces onto one API command before writer transfer; do not leave /api/quotes/[quoteId]/convert and /api/orders/create as independent canonical mutation paths.
Submit an Order only from a canonical Quote already in customer_accepted state and bind the command to the exact Quote objectVersion and quoteEconomicsVersionId returned by API readback.
Do not reinterpret margin approval as customer acceptance and do not let model, browser or caller fields mint acceptance, actor, tenant, authority or effect state.
Submit one exact positive integer quantity for every canonical Order line when recording a Fulfillment Intent and preserve idempotency keys across retries.
Treat RECORDED_NO_EFFECT as internal intent only; it is not dispatch, supplier contact, provider acknowledgement, source confirmation or fulfillment completion.
activation_requirements: independent UI evidence for customer-acceptance provenance and exact Quote version preservation
LUZIONE_API_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true only in the selected approved environment
the exact canary tenant in LUZIONE_API_DOMAIN_COMMAND_TENANTS
verified exact order and fulfillment-intent route capabilities
documented rollback to the existing UI writer and tested retirement/disablement of the competing create route
no provider or broad-tenant activation from this handoff alone
acceptance_proof_needed: exact UI and API SHAs plus luzione-order-fulfillment-intent/v0.1
accepted exact Quote to Order shadow equality including lines, cents, currency and linkage
wrong-status, stale-version, prior-conversion, missing-approval and cross-tenant denial
same-key replay, changed-payload conflict, receipt reconciliation and tested rollback
exact Fulfillment Intent line matching and evidence that no dispatch/provider/payment/booking effect was activated
one canonical UI mutation path after cutover

The API paths remain globally and tenant-default-off and are not active writers.
Customer acceptance remains an input from the current canonical UI path; API-PC-010 does not define a customer-acceptance command.
Managed migration, domain RLS, canary rollback, competing-route retirement and production observation remain unproven.
